text:
ada: starting a config-only rollout (thin-batch) during the 2h change window. plan: 5% -> 25% over 40m. tweaks: `max_batch_size=48` (was 64), `idle_batch_timeout=6ms` (was 3ms), route fallback weight to quant-approx=0.15. no model bump.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: env=prod, type=config-only, canary=5%, id=cfg-20260322-02, initiator=ada

chris: confirming change window + that we have a rollback hook. ping me at 25% so i can watch routing balance.

ada: rollback hook = `/deploy abort cfg-20260322-02` or rollback via console to previous config. auto-halting gate: if p99 climbs > 40ms or error rate > 1.8x baseline for 3m.

oncall: i'll be monitoring SLOs + tenant error heatmap. set alerts to @oncall. also enable 0.5% sampling of requests for full traces.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 5% (t+0). metrics: p50/p95 stable, p99 +8ms.

nina: small note: idle timeout decrease may reduce latency for small requests but could split batches more. watching batch histograms.

adam: (typo) means ada: noted. added a note in release notes draft about potential more fragmented batches.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 15% (auto after 15m). gating: p99 +18ms, 5xx steady. cost delta ~ -2.2% token CPU. Continue?

chris: go ahead to 25% if oncall comfortable. i want tracing toggled on for 1% of low-latency requests to ensure we don't miss regressions.

oncall: toggled tracing sample to 1%. also opened quick query to list tenants with increased inflight queues: https://grafana/redwood/d/ef12/queueing?orgId=1

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 25% (manual). summary: p99 +25ms in aggregate, but heavy-tenant slice shows +60ms.

nina: heavy-tenant bursters showing queue growth. applying per-tenant limiter `smallburst_limit=6` for tenants in heavy list (T-3,T-9). applying as staged override.

adA: (correction) ada: applied overrides. after override, T-3 p99 dropped from 520ms -> 210ms within 90s. overall p99 back to ~200ms.

oncall: good fix. recommendation: pause rollout and collect 30m of steady-state metrics before promoting to 100%. also create rollout note for customers (product-ops looped).

product-ops: copying support + docs: please prepare short comms: what changed, who is affected, how to revert at tenant level. i'll draft the external note.

adeploy-bot: Deploy paused at 25% per request by ada. canary_id=cfg-20260322-02, status=paused

ada: thanks team. next steps: finalize release note PR, add tenant-level revert snippet in runbook (example: `config overrides set smallburst_limit=unbounded --tenant T-3`), and schedule a follow-up postmortem if we see new regressions.

chris: thumbs up. good catch on the per-tenant behavior — we should add a preflight that scans for high concurrency tenants before similar batch changes.

ada: agreed. i'll add a checklist item to the release template.
